scenicChapters.title: Wicklow Mountains Military Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 53 km. 495 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Wicklow Mountains Military Road
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 21 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Wicklow Mountains Military Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 11 km this is Wicklow Mountains Military Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

wicklow-mountains-military-road.story: A 90 km one-way ride from near Dublin, about 1 h 33 of riding. On the way it passes Sally Gap, Glenmacnass Waterfall and Glendalough. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
